No market-wide halt found. No veto. Moves are fractions; percents are in this summary.

WMT.notes: No hard flags. WMT at 125.54 is -1.55% vs 127.52 adj prev close, well under 5%. Report date is confirmed by Walmart's release dated 11/12/2026 and by Robinhood (verified=true, am). Results at 04:00 PT and the call at 05:00 PT both precede the 06:45 PT exit. The WMT SEC index since 11/1 holds only one 8-K (11/16, board appointment), a Form 3 and Forms 4/13F: no guidance pre-announcement, merger, tender or officer departure. Found no date change, trading halt, short-seller report or pending court ruling in the last 10 days, and the DOJ opioid civil trial is set for Nov 2027. Context: WMT fell about 9% after Q2 (8/20/2026) and fell after Q1 (5/21/2026), so post-earnings moves have been large. Q3 guide adj EPS 0.62-0.64 vs consensus 0.64.
